system.description: When a hostile creature within 10 feet of a clone or Bunshin casts a jutsu that grants them hit points or temporary hit points, you can spend 1 Superiority Die and a Reaction. When you do, your clones bully them. Roll 1d8 for every clone within 10 feet of them. they reduce the amount of hit points or temporary hit points gained by the result.
